name: Navattic
tagline: Navattic is an interactive demo platform for building no-code product tours that marketing teams embed on websites and landing pages. Prospects can click through a guided walkthrough of the actual product interface before ever signing up. It integrates with HubSpot, Salesforce, and marketing automation tools to track which prospects engaged with which demos.
